meta.task: Add a payments feature to my web app — build it, test it, verify it in the browser, review it, and ship
meta.title: Ship a Payments Feature End-to-End

nodes.label: Gather scope + acceptance criteria
nodes.description: Collect the feature spec, payment-provider keys, edge cases, and what done looks like.

nodes.label: Trawl the codebase for conventions
nodes.description: Grep and read file after file to learn routing patterns, error handling, naming, and where payments-adjacent code already lives.

nodes.label: Plan files, schema, and API surface
nodes.description: Decide the migration, endpoints, UI components, and how failure states flow through the app.

nodes.label: Write the feature
nodes.description: Implement the migration, API handlers, and checkout UI against the plan.

nodes.label: Write tests after the fact
nodes.description: Backfill unit and integration tests around code that already exists, guessing at the cases that matter.

nodes.label: Run the test suite
nodes.description: Run everything and collect the failures.

nodes.label: Suite green?
nodes.description: All tests passing, including the new ones?

nodes.label: Debug the failures
nodes.description: Chase stack traces and assertion diffs; patch code or tests until the suite settles.

nodes.label: Click through the flows by hand
nodes.description: Boot the app, walk every checkout path, watch the network tab, babysit redirects and webhook callbacks in person.

nodes.label: Screenshot and file the evidence
nodes.description: Capture every state by hand, name the files, and organize the artifacts for the review.

nodes.label: Re-read the whole diff
nodes.description: One long pass over the change set for quality, security, and the money-handling mistakes you cannot afford.

nodes.label: Deploy to staging and smoke-test
nodes.description: Ship to staging, tail the logs, and run a live test charge.

nodes.label: Ship it
nodes.description: Merge and release with the evidence attached.

suggestions.name: safishamsi/graphify
suggestions.claim: Turns a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph so agents reason over structure instead of grepping.

replaceWith.label: Query the code knowledge graph
replaceWith.description: Ask graphify for the conventions, patterns, and payments-adjacent touch points in one query.

suggestions.name: obra/superpowers
suggestions.claim: A full engineering methodology (brainstorm→plan→TDD→review) that turns one-shot vibe coding into disciplined shipping.

replaceWith.label: TDD via superpowers
replaceWith.description: Failing tests come first and drive the implementation — test design stops being an afterthought.

suggestions.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
suggestions.claim: Gives Claude live eyes on a real browser — debugging, performance traces, and page inspection in one MCP.
suggestions.install: claude mcp add chrome-devtools -- npx chrome-devtools-mcp@latest

replaceWith.label: Drive the browser via MCP
replaceWith.description: chrome-devtools-mcp walks the checkout flows, reads console and network, and captures the evidence — no hand-babysitting.
